CounterChange.description:
Move a counter: `adjust` shifts it by a delta, clamped to the counter's own bounds;
`spend` pays a cost from it and refuses when the pool cannot cover it.

mode.description: `adjust` moves the pool, `spend` pays from it and can refuse.
mode.title: Mode

counter.title: Counter

amount.description: For `adjust`, how much the pool moves: negative to reduce. For `spend`, how much of the pool is paid, always positive.
amount.title: Amount

maximum.description: A new upper bound for the pool. Adjust, and advancement only.
maximum.title: Maximum

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.

SetNote.description:
Write freeform bookkeeping the fiction needs remembered and no counter or tag holds, such as
what a caster concentrates on. Writing a key again replaces what it held.

SetNumber.description:
Set a number the fiction has lastingly changed — armour worn, a permanent blessing. Never
for this turn's outcome: pools that go up and down are counters.

TagChange.description:
Put a lasting condition, edge, or burden on an entity, or lift one the fiction ends. The
sheet shows the id written out: `battle-worn` appears as Battle Worn.

mode.description: `add` puts the tag on, `remove` lifts one the entity carries.
mode.title: Mode

tag_id.description: Stable slug for the tag, such as `poisoned`; to remove, the exact id of a tag the entity carries.
tag_id.title: Tag Id

text.description: The constraint or benefit it puts on the entity, in prose. Adding only.
